translations.web: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
translations.bsb: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
translations.kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
translations.asv: Ye know that after two days the passover cometh, and the Son of man is delivered up to be crucified.
